scientific_question: On a task-reachability-filtered train panel, does matched supervision from student-visited recovery states transfer better than matched supervision from successful oracle states?
hypothesis: H1.11-H1.13 fit successful targets without fresh-task transfer, while H1.14 captured student recovery states. If source-state distribution is causal, STUDENT-RECOVERY should selectively outperform SUCCESS-STATE and BASE on fresh tasks under matched teacher, target, and optimizer budgets.
independent_variable: training source-state distribution only: successful oracle states versus student-visited recovery states

arms.BASE: frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct with no new adapter
arms.SUCCESS-STATE: rank-4 SD-LoRA trained on Qwen2.5-14B labels from deterministic-oracle successful states on the six reachable H1.14 train tasks
arms.STUDENT-RECOVERY: rank-4 SD-LoRA trained on the existing Qwen2.5-14B labels from student-visited recovery states on the same six reachable H1.14 train tasks

training_panel.oracle_state_selection: first four admissible deterministic-oracle states per acquisition seed, including search/target/options states and excluding post-buy states
training_panel.success_state_materialization: deterministic oracle path states, then the same frozen Qwen2.5-14B teacher labels the next action; no evaluation task or outcome is visible
training_panel.recovery_state_materialization: existing H1.14 parser-valid student states and Qwen2.5-14B recovery labels, filtered to the six reachable training tasks

owner_audit.service: eight independent vLLM Qwen3.5-9B services with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0..7
owner_audit.allocation: external workload occupies all eight GPUs; do not interfere

invalid_materialization_attempt.classification: serialization failure; excluded from all denominators

evaluation_panel.task_role: fresh held-out evaluation only; no outcome or trace flows to either training dataset

frozen_variables.training_budget: rank 4 q_proj/v_proj; one epoch; four optimizer steps; bfloat16; equal 96-record source budgets
frozen_variables.evaluation: frozen artifact alone; no teacher, memory carrier, prompt rescue, or action post-processing

required: six training task IDs disjoint from eight evaluation task IDs
evaluation seeds disjoint from acquisition seeds
same teacher identity and labeling contract for both training arms
unreachable tasks excluded before label matching
contamination_check.fail_closed: missing control labels, task overlap, teacher mismatch, or source-state identity mismatch invalidates the group and prevents GPU launch

resource_budget.cell_design: 3 arms x 4 partitions x 8 attempts = 96 attempts; UUID-bound independent cells, first wave uses eight authorized GPUs
resource_budget.expected_gpu_hours: bounded two-adapter four-step fit plus 96 evaluation attempts; record actual per-cell wall time and UUID ledger
resource_budget.launch_gate: do not launch until both 96-record datasets, their manifests/hashes, the fresh evaluation manifest, and eight genuinely idle authorized UUIDs are verified

stop_rule: one reachability-filtered source-state diagnostic; no rank/LR/epoch sweep, no post-test task removal, no prompt rescue, and no Q3 claim from fit alone

branch_rule.selective_recovery_positive: independent new-task/new-seed confirmation before Q3; keep H2/D0 closed
branch_rule.negative_or_task_specific: do not stack parametric micro-variants; retain interface/task-family diagnosis and keep Q3/H2/D0/retention/transfer/SEED closed
branch_rule.invalid: repair provenance/materialization only without changing source-state semantics

upstream_audit.decision: retain pinned upstream; use official SD-LoRA semantics and do not import unrelated agent-system evolution

claim_boundary: Reachability-filtered source-state diagnosis only; no Q3 opening, H2, D0, retention/transfer, or SEED claim before independent confirmation.
